//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the RADIO component — the native radio with Pure Admin chrome `.pa-radio` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Form.radio/1`, svelte `forms/Radio.svelte`). SCOPE = the canonical radio tree from snippets/forms.html:256-274: a `<label class="pa-radio ...">` wrapping a native `<input type="radio">` and (when a label is set) a `<span class="pa-radio__label">`. Modifiers in main.css: size (xs/sm/lg/xl), label-end/start/top. NOTE the deltas from checkbox: radio has NO __box element (only __label), NO --disabled class (disabled is the native attr only — snippets/forms.html:588-593), and NO --x. disabled/required are NATIVE attrs on the <input>. name + value are native attrs; `value` is REQUIRED by both wrappers (keen `attr value, required: true`; svelte `value` required prop) so every scenario supplies it. CHECKED is OUT OF SCOPE as a strict feature: the two wrappers derive it through incompatible mechanisms — keen takes a `checked` boolean attr, svelte has NO `checked` prop and instead derives it from `bind:group` (checked iff group === value), which has no neutral single-prop representation. ID is OUT OF SCOPE too: keen radio/1 has an `id` attr, svelte Radio has no id prop. Both are prose-deferred. The `pa-radio-group` container is a SEPARATE component. See checkbox.json for the sibling control model.

propsVocabulary.size: xs|sm|lg|xl — scales the native radio input (default is the unmodified md radio). Shared scale with input/select; emits pa-radio--{size}.
propsVocabulary.labelPosition: end|start|top — label placement relative to the input → pa-radio--label-{pos}. `end` is the visual default but still emits the (redundant, valid) class when set explicitly; unset = classless. Requires the __label span, which both wrappers always emit when a label is present.
propsVocabulary.label: label text — rendered inside <span class="pa-radio__label">. When absent, no label span.
propsVocabulary.name: native name attribute on the <input> (the radio group name)
propsVocabulary.value: native value attribute on the <input> — REQUIRED by both wrappers, always supplied
propsVocabulary.disabled: native boolean attribute on the <input> (there is NO pa-radio--disabled class, unlike checkbox)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the label (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the <label class="pa-radio …"> wrapper + <input type="radio"> + optional <span class="pa-radio__label">. The input always carries type="radio" + value="…" (value is required). There is NO __box span (radio-specific). disabled/required appear only when set and are NATIVE attrs with NO corresponding --disabled class. Boolean attrs are canonicalized to bare presence. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. Block modifiers: size (4), label-end/start/top. Element: pa-radio__label (exercised by the goldens; there is NO pa-radio__box). `produces: null` = native <input> attr (name/value/disabled/required) or slot text (label).

name.note: native name attribute on the input

value.note: native value attribute on the input (required)

disabled.note: native disabled attr — there is NO pa-radio--disabled class

required.note: native required attribute on the input

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the label, not a core feature

deferred.//: pa-radio__box does NOT exist (radio has no drawn box — the native input is styled directly). The two out-of-scope props below are API-divergent and carry no pa-radio class, so they don't affect the axis-1 sweep; recorded for reviewer orientation.
deferred.note-checked: checked state — keen takes a `checked` boolean attr; svelte has no `checked` prop and derives it from bind:group (checked iff group===value). No shared neutral single-prop representation, so it isn't a strict feature here. Verified per-wrapper (keen field tests; svelte group binding).
deferred.note-id: id attribute — keen radio/1 exposes `id`; svelte Radio has no id prop. Out of scope to keep the blessed shape identical.
